_comment: "You may put a card from your hand on the bottom of your deck. IF YOU DO, draw a card." The draw was authored as a 'conditional_effect' key on PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM, which reads no such parameter -- so the whole payoff half of the card was absent and Sink Below only ever bottomed a card. 'If you do' cannot be inferred from a non-empty hand either, because the effect is optional and declining is a legal choice, so PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM now records what it moved and the draw is gated on that. 'optional' was also the STRING "TRUE" rather than the boolean; that happened to be truthy, which is why it was invisible.
